name: Content Calendar
tagline: Owns the posting slots across channels so a multi-bot content stack ships on time
description: Acts as the scheduling brain for content spread over several channels: it hands out posting slots, lines up multi-day arcs, untangles clashes, and holds the line at a single daily post on each channel using your timezone. Writing and publishing stay with the other desks; this one only decides when things go out.
author: ladybarrelmaker
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
